tagline.en: Yale SOM · product, strategy and operations

zh: 我习惯先想清楚“错了代价是什么”。我的背景横跨经济学、咨询、策略和运营。
无论是做市场分析、推进大促，还是用 AI 做产品，我的方式都一样：尽快推到决策，把背后的证据摆出来，并坦白说明哪些地方还不确定。
en: I start by asking what being wrong would cost. My background spans economics, consulting, strategy and operations.
Whether it is market analysis, a sales campaign or an AI product, I work the same way: get to a decision fast, show the evidence behind it, and say plainly what is still uncertain.
